# Printed Hole Depth

Depth of a blind hole compared with its diameter (through holes may be longer).

## Where it applies

| Process | Criticality |
| :-- | :-- |
| [Resin 3D Printing (SLA)](../../reference/processes/resin-3d-printing.md) | Medium |
| [Powder Bed Fusion (SLS)](../../reference/processes/powder-bed-fusion.md) | Medium |

## Values

**Aim for** is what to design for; crossing it gives a warning. **At most** is the hard limit; crossing it gives an error. See [aim for and limits](../../concepts/aim-for-and-limits.md).

=== "Resin 3D Printing (SLA)"

    Criticality in this process: **Medium** ([what this means](../../concepts/criticality.md)).

    | Material | Aim for | At most | Source |
    | :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- |
    | **Default** | 3× its diameter | 8× its diameter | Aim for: Published, [Xometry](../../citations/bibliography.md#xometry-lspc "Blind holes under 3 times their diameter (recommended); through holes get 8/3 of this")<br>At most: Published, [Xometry](../../citations/bibliography.md#xometry-lspc "Blind holes under 8 times their diameter (achievable); through holes get 8/3 of this") |

    Every other material uses the Default values: Standard Resin, Tough / Durable Resin, Flexible / Elastic Resin.


=== "Powder Bed Fusion (SLS)"

    Criticality in this process: **Medium** ([what this means](../../concepts/criticality.md)).

    | Material | Aim for | At most | Source |
    | :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- |
    | **Default** | 3× its diameter | 8× its diameter | Engineering judgement, [Xometry](../../citations/bibliography.md#xometry-lspc "Resin's Xometry figures. HLH and Fast Radius say deep and blind holes trap powder, without a figure"), [HLH Prototypes](../../citations/bibliography.md#hlh-sls), [Fast Radius](../../citations/bibliography.md#fast-radius-mjf) |

    Every other material uses the Default values: PA12 (SLS), PA12 (MJF), PA11, PA12 Carbon-filled, TPU.


## Messages

What the results panel says about a finding. You can rewrite these in the Process Library; the words in `{braces}` are filled in for each finding.

=== "Resin 3D Printing (SLA)"

    !!! warning "Warning"

        Deep narrow hole (`{measured}` its diameter): `{feature}` is `{size}`, past the recommended `{target}` its diameter. Uncured resin is hard to wash out of it. Widen or shorten it, or make it a through hole.
    !!! failure "Error"

        Hole too deep to clean (`{measured}` its diameter): `{feature}` is `{size}`, past `{limit}` its diameter. Resin will stay in it and cure, closing it up. Widen or shorten it, or make it a through hole.

=== "Powder Bed Fusion (SLS)"

    !!! warning "Warning"

        Deep narrow hole (`{measured}` its diameter): `{feature}` is `{size}`, past the recommended `{target}` its diameter. Powder packs into deep holes and is hard to blast out. Widen or shorten it, or make it a through hole.
    !!! failure "Error"

        Hole too deep to clear (`{measured}` its diameter): `{feature}` is `{size}`, past `{limit}` its diameter. Powder will stay packed in it. Make it a through hole, or widen or shorten it.

| Placeholder | Replaced with |
| :-- | :-- |
| `{measured}` | The measured value, with its unit |
| `{target}` | The rule's "Aim for" value |
| `{limit}` | The rule's "At most" value |
| `{feature}` | What it is about, such as "Boss 3 (screw)" or "Face12" |
| `{size}` | Its size or what was found, such as "Ø3.00 mm and 9.00 mm deep" |
| `{hole_kind}` | "blind" or "through" |
